title: pvWriteMetaImageWriter
body:
## pvWriteMetaImageWriter

Explicit-export writer for MetaImage (.mhd): a short text header (dimensions, spacing, element type) plus a separate binary data file, the format read by ITK-based medical-imaging and segmentation tools. The input must be one non-composite vtkImageData; VTK writes the image scalars and compresses the data file by default. Schemaxis publishes it under the pixels contract: the file is read back and dimensions, component count and scalar values are compared, while coordinates and other fields are accepted as lost. Use pvWriteTIFFWriter or pvWritePNGWriter for 2-D raster interchange, or automatic VTK XML image output (.vti) to keep all arrays.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Only the image scalars are carried; make the array you need the active point scalars, or export VTK XML image data when several arrays matter.
- Keep the header and its data file together when moving the result; the header refers to the data file by name.
- An earlier catalogue run (verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json, writerQualification) passed only on a small serial fixture with default options; no current native acceptance check is recorded, so verify the export on representative data.

Native constructor: `MetaImageWriter`. Identity: `writers/MetaImageWriter`. Role: `writer`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Connect upstream object to `Input` | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

No authored options.


Output publication contract:

```json
{
  "comparison": "pixels",
  "extensions": [
    "mhd"
  ],
  "filenames": "managed output directory",
  "losses": [
    "coordinates",
    "fields"
  ],
  "qualification": "requires fixture",
  "time": "one scheduled state"
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "explicit exports with semantic readback",
  "outputPorts": 0,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `scenes[].exports`; writers cannot be graph nodes. The main data input is `node`; non-data ports go in `resources`.

```json
{
  "id": "exportResult",
  "node": "DATA_NODE",
  "writer": "pvWriteMetaImageWriter",
  "acceptLosses": [
    "coordinates",
    "fields"
  ]
}
```
